pageIntro.label: Other
pageIntro.description: Not everything worth knowing belongs on a résumé. These are a few things that have shaped who I am beyond work and university.

basketball.title: Playing basketball
basketball.description: Basketball has been part of my life for more than twelve years. I value the pace of the game, the shared experience of being part of a team and the constant challenge of improving over time.

aviation.title: Fascinated by aviation
aviation.description: I’ve always been fascinated by aviation: the aircraft themselves, the systems behind every flight and the enormous amount of coordination required to move people safely around the world.
